description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Amazing Home:* Beach access- ONLY 250 yards away* 8 Bedrooms/6.5 Baths, 2 Full Kitchens and; Living Rooms* Fenced-in Yard w/ PRIVATE 15x30ft Pool and Round sitting Pool- Heated for add'l $43/nt fee * 6 Fun Pug Bikes Included* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Multiple Balconies, Decks and Huge porch* 1 Mile to Seaside’s Central Square* Professionally Managed; 24/7 service.*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* From the moment you arrive at Aweigh From Home, you will start a new vacation tradition of a lifetime! Perfect for family reunions and gatherings, this magnificent, 4129 sq ft home is just off Hwy 30A in Seagrove Beach, and boasts its own 15x30ft Private Pool with a round sitting pool. Only 250 yards to the beach and under 1 mile from Seaside, you are right in the heart of all things 30A! Aweigh From Home features 8 bedrooms, 6.5 baths,and sleeps up to 20 guests comfortably. There are 3 king beds, 5 queen beds, and 2 sets of twin bunks. This incredible home has TWO large Living Rooms, TWO fully equipped kitchens,a huge wraparound porch w/ rocking chairs, a grilling deck, and a TopFloor Balcony facing the Gulf! Relax poolside on the fenced-in pool deck with plenty of lounge chairs. Stroll down to the beach anytime you want, just 250 yards away! Sip your beverage of choice on the spacious Top Floor balcony w/ bar tables and chairs. Hungry? Walk a couple blocks to Surfing Deer and check out the fantastic cuisine in Seaside, or head a few miles east to The Big Chill on 30A. The driveway has plenty of parking, so bring your friends and family. This is truly the all-in-one vacation you have been looking for!The Bed Setup:Main House: Sleeps: 161st FloorGuest Bedroom: Two Queen BedsGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Bunk BedsMaster Bedroom #1: King Bed and Private Bath2nd FloorMaster Bedroom #2: King Bed and Private Bath3rd floorGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest House: Sleeps: 42nd FloorGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions:Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.“The Big Chill” is the community center for Prominence and is only a few miles away. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila, to wings, burgers and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
